title: Published news: source review
explanation: Changes are review signals, not proof of an error. Unchanged text does not confirm current facts. This check never rewrites or unpublishes an article.
unavailable: Source review is unavailable. Other news tools still work.
enabled: Daily checks follow the enabled news scheduler.
disabled: News automation is off; scheduled source checks are paused.
coverage: Covers news created by the news pipeline and published in the last {days} days; checks up to {limit} articles daily, with a {interval}-day interval between attempts (including incomplete checks). Older and manually imported articles are excluded.
counts: {total} articles in scope · {due} due · {shown} shown (changed sources first).
empty: No matching articles in this review window.
